subject: Final MAP sign-off & readiness for signature
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & MAP draft (next steps)

Hi Samir / Elena —

Great to meet this morning. Quick recap and the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) attached for your review. High-level:

- Goal: Production inference for Acme Logistics customer tracking flows (reduced latency + cost target).
- Proposed target close: 2026-03-24 (we discussed a late-March TO-BE contract execution).
- Key milestones (draft):
  1) Finalize MAP & SOW (Responsible: Acme procurement + Redwood AE) — target 2026-03-10
  2) Security questionnaire review & evidence handoff (Responsible: Acme + Redwood Security) — target 2026-03-12
  3) Contract signature (DocuSign) — target 2026-03-24
  4) Onboarding kickoff (CS) — target 2026-04-13
  5) Go-live / production window — target 2026-04-20

Open items for you:
- Please confirm the procurement contact who will receive the SOW/SLA (you mentioned procurement@acme.com).
- Any changes to milestone owners or dates?
- Are the success criteria listed on the MAP aligned with your Ops team (latency p95 < 300ms, cost-per-1k-tokens target)?

Attachments: MAP_Acme_V3.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_Acme_draft_v2.pdf (SOW draft)

Thanks — I’ll iterate the MAP once I have your comments.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & MAP draft (next steps)

Thanks Marissa —

Overall this looks great. A few notes from our side after reviewing with Ops and Legal:
- Can we move the contract signature up a bit? If we can get the SOW finalized by 03/10, procurement can target 03/18 for signature instead of 03/24.
- Ops requests an extra milestone: Security runbook handoff and validation with our infra team (Responsible: Redwood Security + Acme Infra) — suggested target 03/12.
- Success criteria: please include an item for "stable throughput at 500 req/s for 30m window" in addition to latency/cost KPIs.

I'll loop Elena (product lead) and Procurement on any redlines. Procurement is procurement@acme.com — they will want the final SOW in DocuSign.

Samir
Head of Product\Acme Logistics

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-04T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAP & next steps

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the quick review and the procurement contact. I updated the MAP per your notes (attached MAP_Acme_V3.xlsx — version includes the security runbook milestone and the throughput success criterion). Changes made:
- Contract signature target moved to 2026-03-18 (procurement dependent)
- Added milestone: Security runbook handoff & validation (target 2026-03-12) — Responsible: Redwood Security (Monica) + Acme Infra (Samir)
- Added success criterion: stable throughput 500 req/s for 30m window

Next actions from Redwood:
- Marissa will send the updated SOW to procurement via DocuSign once you confirm the MAP (target 03/10).
- Vanessa (CS) will prepare onboarding checklist and kickoff plan for 2026-04-13 — Vanessa, I’ve looped you here to sync.
- Monica, please be ready to share SOC-2 evidence and the security runbook by 03/11.

Attachments: MAP_Acme_V3.xlsx (updated)

Thanks — I’ll be ready to turn around any follow-up redlines.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive\Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>

Date: 2026-03-09T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP & next steps

Rishi / Marissa —

This version looks aligned with Product and Ops. A couple of confirmations from my side:
- We confirm the success criteria (latency p95 < 300ms, throughput stable at 500 req/s for 30m, cost target as discussed).
- Go-live window 2026-04-20 is acceptable.
- Procurement confirms they require the final SOW in DocuSign and a fully executed MAP attached to the contract.

Please send the final SOW and MAP to procurement@acme.com when ready and mark me as approver. Once Procurement receives DocuSign, they will route for signature.

Thanks — Elena
Director of Product\Acme Logistics

Thanks for the confirmations. This thread confirms Redwood's readiness to proceed to signature. Summary of final items:

- MAP: finalized and attached (MAP_Acme_V3.xlsx) — includes milestones, owners, success criteria, and target dates.
- SOW: SOW_Acme_draft_v2.pdf attached; will push to DocuSign for procurement@acme.com and Elena Ruiz as approver.
- Security: Monica will provide SOC-2 evidence and the runbook by 2026-03-11.
- Onboarding: Vanessa will run kickoff week of 2026-04-13 — tentative date 2026-04-13 (team availability to be confirmed).
- Contract signature target: 2026-03-18 (procurement dependent)

Please confirm two things by EOD 2026-03-11:
1) Procurement contact (confirming procurement@acme.com is correct)
2) Any final redlines to the SOW we should include before sending to DocuSign

If we receive no redlines, I will initiate the DocuSign envelope first thing 03/12 and mark Elena as approver.
